info.title: Todos API
info.description: The Todos API. Every route lives under `/api/v1`. Request bodies are strict: unknown keys are rejected. Every non-2xx response the API generates is the error envelope `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`; clients branch on `code`, never on `message`. A gateway in front of the API (nginx in the production-like stack) may answer with a non-JSON body instead: 502 or 504 when the API is unreachable, and 413 for a body over the gateway's own limit (32 KiB). Treat any error without the envelope as `INTERNAL`.
